verdict.rationale: Phaser Editor documents an MCP Server with over 40 specialised tools that external agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Copilot) can call. The editor page says it can create particle emitters, reorganise scenes into layers and rename objects, which is programmatic automation of scene manipulation. The probe, however, ties the official MCP to the hosted Game Agent, so it is unclear how directly it drives the editor. There is no evidence of a plugin API, editor scripting or custom-tool authoring for extending the editor itself. Missing for 10: documented editor plugin/extension API, editor scripting for custom tools, programmatic asset-pipeline automation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP editor tools.
